input.quote: Section 8.3 Termination. This Agreement will terminate on the earlier to occur of (a) the date upon which the last remaining Receivable is paid in full, settled, sold or written off and any amounts received are applied and (b) the Issuer is terminated under Section 8.1 of the Trust Agreement.
input.rationale: This transfer and servicing agreement contains no renewal mechanic at all. Searches for "renew", "automatically renew", "successive", "extension/expire", "term of this Agreement" and fee-escalation language return no auto-renewal term, no non-renewal notice window and no price-uplift right; the term simply runs under Section 8.3 (p0363) until the last Receivable is paid in full/settled/sold/written off or the Issuer is terminated under the Trust Agreement. Because renewal is not automatic and no price increase is permitted, each conditional fallback element (60-day non-renewal window; 5% uplift cap) and each conditional preferred element (12-month renewal term, 30-day opt-out, 60-day reminder, CPI/3% cap) is satisfied vacuously, and any extension of this self-liquidating term could only be effected by the parties amending the Agreement in writing under Section 10.4 (p0392) — i.e. by mutual written agreement, the preferred position. There is nothing here that traps us in a renewal or exposes us to an uncapped uplift, so no redline is warranted; inserting a renewal-and-uplift construct into a securitization structure that terminates on final payment would be inapposite.
